metric_definitions.music_f1: Voice, pitch (string/fret for pure TAB), onset and actual duration must agree.
metric_definitions.timed_chord_f1: Chord name, part, staff, bar, voice and onset must agree; header diagram libraries do not create timed chords.
metric_definitions.annotation: Fixed annotation crops; geometric diagram refinement reported separately from raw model outputs.
metric_definitions.whole_pdf: Predicted layout, metadata, part grouping, timeline and music. Missing bars reduce music scores; extra bars are counted separately for the original single-part corpus and included in ensemble score metrics.

validation.note: Parent-teacher measurements are historical selection evidence; the held-out section evaluates the final refined model and final decoding.

scope: Native engraved, composed, synthetic and simulated scan scores. These measurements do not establish arbitrary photograph or handwriting accuracy.
